credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: This album of 48 black and white photographs was created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Yosemite Album
